author: PokerFace
body:
Hi Developers,

I was wondering if you could make a new forum section on the website under the "Map Development" category called Build Events or something of the sort. Build contests have been held many times and, I think they should have the right to their own place on the forums other than in the Avicus Lounge section. 

Please give permission for the Map Devs to be able to post in that section. Also, if it isn't too much, there are some regular players (like myself) who help with these build contests. If we could have permissions to post in that category as well, that would be swell. Thanks! Also, if you want me to make a list of all the people who are helping with this, I can make one.

replies.author: Infivix
replies.body: I don't think its a big enough subject to be a sub-forum, but it's a good idea.

replies.author: Mango_
replies.body: We don't really need it to be honest. Contests aren't held often enough to have a dedicated sub-forum in my opinion.

replies.author: PokerFace
replies.body:
I can see where you guys are coming from. You guys are right but sooner or later, there is going to be 20+ events and I don't see why it should wait until a certain number of events had happened. And there is like no other sub-forum category that is fit for the Build Contests. 

I'd also like to point out that the Looking for Scrimmage page has 9 posts while there have been 10 posts for the build competitions.
